entities.name: Brandon Ríos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brandon Lee Ríos is an American former professional boxer. He held the WBA Regular lightweight title in 2011 and has challenged once for the WBO welterweight title in 2015. Nicknamed "Bam Bam", Ríos was known for his aggressive pressure fighting style, formidable punching power, and exceptionally durable chin during his prime.
